title: Tape agrees with table fields
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration of a machine with $K$ work tapes on input $x$, let $r$ be one of its work tapes, let $o$ be an integer, and let $h$ and $es$ be lists of lists of symbols. The contents of tape $r$ at position $o+p$ must equal the prescribed tape encoding of the table fields at position $p$ for every integer $p$ from $-2$ through one more than the length of the joined fields.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an index of one of the $K$ work tapes
$p$ ranges over integers satisfying $-2\le p$ and $p\le$ the joined-field length plus $1$
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the joined-fields or tape-encoding functions, so their exact mathematical meaning cannot be recovered here.
